name: metabase-ai-assistant
description: The most powerful MCP Server for Metabase — 152 tools with dbt metadata sync, reverse lineage exposures, smart question creator, Lightdash YAML Code-as-BI, Cube.js pre-aggregations, Omni semantic bridge & enterprise BI.
long_description:
Connect Claude to your Metabase instance with 152 specialized tools.

**Features:**
- dbt Metadata to Metabase Auto-Syncer (tables, descriptions, semantic types, FKs)
- dbt MetricFlow to Official Metabase Metrics Sync
- Metabase to dbt Reverse Lineage Exposures Generator (_metabase__exposures.yml)
- dbt-Smart Card / Question Creator with verified business rules
- dbt Deep Scanning, MetricFlow & dbt Docs Profiling
- Lightdash-style Code-as-BI YAML to 24-column Metabase Dashboard Builder
- Cube.js-style Pre-Aggregation, Rollup DDL & Multi-Hop Lineage Joins
- Omni.co-style Controlled Semantic-to-YAML Exporter
- Autonomous Self-Healing SQL execution & AI generation
- Proactive Anomaly & Outlier Detection
- AI Query Index & Materialized View Advisor
- Enterprise PII & Sensitive Data Sanitizer

Requires a running Metabase instance with API access.
